text.lead: The Happy Poet is a 2010 film written and directed by Paul Gordon. It was shot on-location in Austin, Texas, US. It has appeared at a number of film festivals, including the Venice Film Festival 's Giornate Degli Autori ("Authors' Days") section.
text.cast:
- Paul Gordon
- Jonny Mars
- Chris Doubek
- Liz Fisher
- Amy Myers Martin
- Ricardo Lerma
- Sam Wainwright Douglas
- Carlos Trevino
